title: Venezuelan Chocolate Empanadas
description: Warm, sweet empanadas filled with rich chocolate, a delightful Venezuelan treat.
instructions: Roll out the empanada dough to desired thickness.
Cut out circles of dough for the empanada shells.
Mix together the chocolate and milk until smooth.
Place a spoonful of chocolate mixture onto one half of each dough circle.
Fold the dough in half and press edges to seal the empanada.
Brush tops of empanadas with a little milk for a golden glaze.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
